verdict.rationale: Attio documents a Deal object (disabled by default and admin-activated) and lists that model business processes. It also offers kanban views ('From kanbans to tables'), and its reporting references stage conversion, weighted pipeline and stuck deals, so a visual deal pipeline with stages is clearly implied. However, none of the evidence explicitly documents configuring pipeline stages or moving deals between them by drag-and-drop. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of customizable pipeline stages, documented drag-and-drop stage updates on the kanban, independent or hands-on corroboration.
